verses.original: כִּי־ יִמָּצֵ֣א חָלָ֗ל נֹפֵ֖ל בַּשָּׂדֶ֑ה בָּאֲדָמָה֙ אֲשֶׁר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ נֹתֵ֤ן לְךָ֙ לְרִשְׁתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א נוֹדַ֖ע מִ֥י הִכָּֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- yim·mā·ṣê ḥā·lāl nō·p̄êl baś·śā·ḏeh bā·’ă·ḏā·māh ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā lə·riš·tāh lō nō·w·ḏa‘ mî hik·kā·hū
verses.literal: If [one] is found slain lying in a field in the land that the LORD your God is giving you to possess and it is not known who killed him

verses.original: זְקֵנֶ֖יךָ וְשֹׁפְטֶ֑יךָ וְיָצְא֥וּ וּמָדְדוּ֙ הֶחָלָֽל׃ אֶל־ סְבִיבֹ֥ת הֶ֣עָרִ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֖ר
verses.transliteration: zə·qê·ne·ḵā wə·šō·p̄ə·ṭe·ḵā wə·yā·ṣə·’ū ū·mā·ḏə·ḏū he·ḥā·lāl ’el- sə·ḇî·ḇōṯ he·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer
verses.literal: your elders and judges must come out and measure the distance from the victim to the neighboring cities -

verses.original: וְהָיָ֣ה זִקְנֵי֩ הָעִ֨יר הַהִ֜וא הָעִ֔יר הַקְּרֹבָ֖ה אֶל־ הֶחָלָ֑ל וְלָֽקְח֡וּ עֶגְלַ֣ת בָּקָ֗ר אֲשֶׁ֤ר לֹֽא־ בְּעֹֽל׃ עֻבַּד֙ בָּ֔הּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ מָשְׁכָ֖ה
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ziq·nê hā·‘îr ha·hi·w hā·‘îr haq·qə·rō·ḇāh ’el- he·ḥā·lāl wə·lā·qə·ḥū ‘eḡ·laṯ bā·qār ’ă·šer lō- bə·‘ōl ‘ub·baḏ bāh ’ă·šer lō- mā·šə·ḵāh
verses.literal: Then the elders . . . . . . of the city nearest - the victim shall take a heifer . . . that has never been yoked or used for work

verses.original: וְהוֹרִ֡דוּ זִקְנֵי֩ הַהִ֤וא אֶת־ הָעִ֨יר הָֽעֶגְלָה֙ אֶל־ נַ֣חַל אֵיתָ֔ן אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא־ יֵעָבֵ֥ד בּ֖וֹ וְלֹ֣א יִזָּרֵ֑עַ הָעֶגְלָ֖ה וְעָֽרְפוּ־ שָׁ֥ם אֶת־ בַּנָּֽחַל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hō·w·ri·ḏū ziq·nê ha·hi·w ’eṯ- hā·‘îr hā·‘eḡ·lāh ’el- na·ḥal ’ê·ṯān ’ă·šer lō- yê·‘ā·ḇêḏ bōw wə·lō yiz·zā·rê·a‘ hā·‘eḡ·lāh wə·‘ā·rə·p̄ū- šām ’eṯ- ban·nā·ḥal
verses.literal: bring - - - - the heifer to a valley with running water that has not been plowed - or sown {and break} its neck there - by the stream

verses.original: הַכֹּהֲנִים֮ בְּנֵ֣י לֵוִי֒ וְנִגְּשׁ֣וּ כִּ֣י בָ֗ם יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֙יךָ֙ בָּחַ֞ר לְשָׁ֣רְת֔וֹ וּלְבָרֵ֖ךְ יְהוָ֑ה בְּשֵׁ֣ם וְעַל־ פִּיהֶ֥ם יִהְיֶ֖ה כָּל־ רִ֥יב וְכָל־ נָֽגַע׃
verses.transliteration: hak·kō·hă·nîm bə·nê lê·wî wə·nig·gə·šū kî ḇām Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā bā·ḥar lə·šā·rə·ṯōw ū·lə·ḇā·rêḵ Yah·weh bə·šêm wə·‘al- pî·hem yih·yeh kāl- rîḇ wə·ḵāl nā·ḡa‘
verses.literal: And the priests the sons of Levi shall come forward for the LORD your God has chosen them to serve Him and pronounce blessings in His name and to give a ruling . . . . . . in every dispute . . . and case of assault

verses.original: וְכֹ֗ל זִקְנֵי֙ הָעִ֣יר הַהִ֔וא הַקְּרֹבִ֖ים אֶל־ הֶחָלָ֑ל יִרְחֲצוּ֙ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֔ם בַנָּֽחַל׃ עַל־ הָעֶגְלָ֖ה הָעֲרוּפָ֥ה
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵōl ziq·nê hā·‘îr ha·hi·w haq·qə·rō·ḇîm ’el- he·ḥā·lāl yir·ḥă·ṣū ’eṯ- yə·ḏê·hem ḇan·nā·ḥal ‘al- hā·‘eḡ·lāh hā·‘ă·rū·p̄āh
verses.literal: Then all the elders of the city . . . nearest - the victim shall wash - their hands by the stream over the heifer whose neck has been broken

verses.original: וְעָנ֖וּ וְאָמְר֑וּ יָדֵ֗ינוּ לֹ֤א שָׁפְכָה אֶת־ הַזֶּ֔ה הַדָּ֣ם לֹ֥א וְעֵינֵ֖ינוּ רָאֽוּ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘ā·nū wə·’ā·mə·rū yā·ḏê·nū lō šå̄·p̄ə·ḵå̄h ’eṯ- haz·zeh had·dām lō wə·‘ê·nê·nū rā·’ū
verses.literal: and they shall declare . . . Our hands did not shed - this blood nor did our eyes see it

verses.original: כַּפֵּר֩ יְהוָ֔ה לְעַמְּךָ֨ יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־ פָּדִ֙יתָ֙ וְאַל־ תִּתֵּן֙ נָקִ֔י דָּ֣ם בְּקֶ֖רֶב עַמְּךָ֣ יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָהֶ֖ם הַדָּֽם׃ וְנִכַּפֵּ֥ר
verses.transliteration: kap·pêr Yah·weh lə·‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl ’ă·šer- pā·ḏî·ṯā wə·’al- tit·tên nā·qî dām bə·qe·reḇ ‘am·mə·ḵā yiś·rā·’êl lā·hem had·dām wə·nik·kap·pêr
verses.literal: Accept this atonement O LORD for Your people Israel whom You have redeemed and do not hold the shedding of innocent blood against them . . . . . . And the bloodshed will be atoned for

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֗ה תְּבַעֵ֛ר מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ הַנָּקִ֖י הַדָּ֥ם כִּֽי־ תַעֲשֶׂ֥ה הַיָּשָׁ֖ר בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh tə·ḇa·‘êr miq·qir·be·ḵā han·nā·qî had·dām kî- ṯa·‘ă·śeh hay·yā·šār bə·‘ê·nê Yah·weh
verses.literal: So you shall purge from among you the guilt of shedding innocent blood since you have done what is right in the eyes of the LORD

verses.original: כִּֽי־ תֵצֵ֥א לַמִּלְחָמָ֖ה עַל־ אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ יְהוָ֧ה אֱלֹהֶ֛יךָ וּנְתָנ֞וֹ בְּיָדֶ֖ךָ וְשָׁבִ֥יתָ שִׁבְיֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- ṯê·ṣê lam·mil·ḥā·māh ‘al- ’ō·yə·ḇe·ḵā Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā ū·nə·ṯā·nōw bə·yā·ḏe·ḵā wə·šā·ḇî·ṯā šiḇ·yōw
verses.literal: When you go to war against your enemies and the LORD your God delivers them into your hand and you take them captive

verses.original: וְרָאִיתָ֙ יְפַת־ תֹּ֑אַר אֵ֖שֶׁת בַּשִּׁבְיָ֔ה וְחָשַׁקְתָּ֣ בָ֔הּ וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ לְךָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·rā·’î·ṯā yə·p̄aṯ- tō·’ar ’ê·šeṯ baš·šiḇ·yāh wə·ḥā·šaq·tā ḇāh wə·lā·qaḥ·tā lə·ḵā lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: if you see a beautiful . . . woman among [them] and you desire her and want to take her as your wife

verses.original: וַהֲבֵאתָ֖הּ אֶל־ תּ֣וֹךְ בֵּיתֶ֑ךָ וְגִלְּחָה֙ אֶת־ רֹאשָׁ֔הּ וְעָשְׂתָ֖ה אֶת־ צִפָּרְנֶֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·hă·ḇê·ṯāh ’el- tō·wḵ bê·ṯe·ḵā wə·ḡil·lə·ḥāh ’eṯ- rō·šāh wə·‘ā·śə·ṯāh ’eṯ- ṣip·pā·rə·ne·hā
verses.literal: then you shall bring her into . . . your house She must shave - her head trim - her nails

verses.original: וְהֵסִ֩ירָה֩ אֶת־ שִׂמְלַ֨ת שִׁבְיָ֜הּ מֵעָלֶ֗יהָ וְאַ֨חַר כֵּ֜ן וְיָֽשְׁבָה֙ בְּבֵיתֶ֔ךָ יֶ֣רַח יָמִ֑ים וּבָֽכְתָ֛ה אֶת־ אָבִ֥יהָ וְאֶת־ אִמָּ֖הּ תָּב֤וֹא אֵלֶ֙יהָ֙ וּבְעַלְתָּ֔הּ וְהָיְתָ֥ה לְךָ֖ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hê·sî·rāh ’eṯ- śim·laṯ šiḇ·yāh mê·‘ā·le·hā wə·’a·ḥar kên wə·yā·šə·ḇāh bə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā ye·raḥ yā·mîm ū·ḇā·ḵə·ṯāh ’eṯ- ’ā·ḇî·hā wə·’eṯ- ’im·māh tā·ḇō·w ’ê·le·hā ū·ḇə·‘al·tāh wə·hā·yə·ṯāh lə·ḵā lə·’iš·šāh
verses.literal: and put aside - the clothing of her captivity After she has lived in your house a full month . . . and mourned - her father - and mother you may have relations with her and be her husband and she shall be your wife

verses.original: וְהָיָ֞ה אִם־ לֹ֧א חָפַ֣צְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְשִׁלַּחְתָּהּ֙ לְנַפְשָׁ֔הּ לֹא־ וּמָכֹ֥ר תִמְכְּרֶ֖נָּה בַּכָּ֑סֶף לֹא־ תִתְעַמֵּ֣ר בָּ֔הּ תַּ֖חַת אֲשֶׁ֥ר עִנִּיתָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’im- lō ḥā·p̄aṣ·tā bāh wə·šil·laḥ·tāh lə·nap̄·šāh lō- ū·mā·ḵōr ṯim·kə·ren·nāh bak·kā·sep̄ lō- ṯiṯ·‘am·mêr bāh ta·ḥaṯ ’ă·šer ‘in·nî·ṯāh
verses.literal: And if you are not pleased with her you are to let her go wherever she wishes But you must not sell her . . . for money . . . or treat her as a slave since - you have dishonored her

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לְאִ֜ישׁ תִהְיֶ֨יןָ שְׁתֵּ֣י נָשִׁ֗ים הָאַחַ֤ת אֲהוּבָה֙ וְהָאַחַ֣ת שְׂנוּאָ֔ה הָאֲהוּבָ֖ה וְהַשְּׂנוּאָ֑ה וְיָֽלְדוּ־ ל֣וֹ בָנִ֔ים לַשְּׂנִיאָֽה׃ וְהָיָ֛ה הַבְּכ֖וֹר הַבֵּ֥ן
verses.transliteration: kî- lə·’îš ṯih·ye·nā šə·tê nā·šîm hā·’a·ḥaṯ ’ă·hū·ḇāh wə·hā·’a·ḥaṯ śə·nū·’āh hā·’ă·hū·ḇāh wə·haś·śə·nū·’āh wə·yā·lə·ḏū- lōw ḇā·nîm laś·śə·nî·’āh wə·hā·yāh hab·bə·ḵō·wr hab·bên
verses.literal: If a man has two wives one beloved and the other unloved and [both] . . . bear him sons but the unloved wife has the firstborn son

verses.original: וְהָיָ֗ה בְּיוֹם֙ אֲשֶׁר־ יִהְיֶ֖ה ל֑וֹ הַנְחִיל֣וֹ אֶת־ בָּנָ֔יו אֵ֥ת לֹ֣א יוּכַ֗ל בֶּן־ הָ֣אֲהוּבָ֔ה עַל־ פְּנֵ֥י בֶן־ לְבַכֵּר֙ אֶת־ הַשְּׂנוּאָ֖ה הַבְּכֹֽר׃
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh bə·yō·wm ’ă·šer- yih·yeh lōw han·ḥî·lōw ’eṯ- bā·nāw ’êṯ lō yū·ḵal ben- hā·’ă·hū·ḇāh ‘al- pə·nê ḇen- lə·ḇak·kêr ’eṯ- haś·śə·nū·’āh hab·bə·ḵōr
verses.literal: when that man . . . assigns his inheritance - to his sons - he must not appoint the son of the beloved wife as the firstborn over [the son] - of the unloved wife . . .

verses.original: כִּי֩ אֶת־ יַכִּ֗יר הַבְּכֹ֨ר בֶּן־ הַשְּׂנוּאָ֜ה לָ֤תֶת לוֹ֙ שְׁנַ֔יִם פִּ֣י בְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ יִמָּצֵ֖א ל֑וֹ כִּי־ הוּא֙ רֵאשִׁ֣ית אֹנ֔וֹ מִשְׁפַּ֥ט הַבְּכֹרָֽה׃ס ל֖וֹ
verses.transliteration: kî ’eṯ- yak·kîr hab·bə·ḵōr ben- haś·śə·nū·’āh lā·ṯeṯ lōw šə·na·yim pî bə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- yim·mā·ṣê lōw kî- hū rê·šîṯ ’ō·nōw miš·paṭ hab·bə·ḵō·rāh lōw
verses.literal: Instead - he must acknowledge the firstborn the son of his unloved wife by giving him a double portion of all that he has For [that son] is the firstfruits of his [father’s] strength the right of the firstborn belongs to him

verses.original: כִּֽי־ לְאִ֗ישׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמוֹרֶ֔ה בֵּ֚ן אֵינֶ֣נּוּ שֹׁמֵ֔עַ בְּק֥וֹל אָבִ֖יו וּבְק֣וֹל אִמּ֑וֹ וְלֹ֥א יִשְׁמַ֖ע אֲלֵיהֶֽם׃ וְיסְּר֣וּ אֹת֔וֹ
verses.transliteration: kî- lə·’îš yih·yeh sō·w·rêr ū·mō·w·reh bên ’ê·nen·nū šō·mê·a‘ bə·qō·wl ’ā·ḇîw ū·ḇə·qō·wl ’im·mōw wə·lō yiš·ma‘ ’ă·lê·hem ws·sə·rū ’ō·ṯōw
verses.literal: If a man has a stubborn and rebellious son who does not obey . . . his father . . . and mother and does not listen to them when disciplined -

verses.original: אָבִ֣יו וְאִמּ֑וֹ וְתָ֥פְשׂוּ ב֖וֹ וְהוֹצִ֧יאוּ אֹת֛וֹ אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֥י עִיר֖וֹ וְאֶל־ שַׁ֥עַר מְקֹמֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: ’ā·ḇîw wə·’im·mōw wə·ṯā·p̄ə·śū ḇōw wə·hō·w·ṣî·’ū ’ō·ṯōw ’el- ziq·nê ‘î·rōw wə·’el- ša·‘ar mə·qō·mōw
verses.literal: his father and mother are to lay hold of him and bring him to the elders of his city to the gate of his hometown

verses.original: וְאָמְר֞וּ אֶל־ זִקְנֵ֣י עִיר֗וֹ זֶה֙ בְּנֵ֤נוּ סוֹרֵ֣ר וּמֹרֶ֔ה אֵינֶ֥נּוּ שֹׁמֵ֖עַ בְּקֹלֵ֑נוּ זוֹלֵ֖ל וְסֹבֵֽא׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ā·mə·rū ’el- ziq·nê ‘î·rōw zeh bə·nê·nū sō·w·rêr ū·mō·reh ’ê·nen·nū šō·mê·a‘ bə·qō·lê·nū zō·w·lêl wə·sō·ḇê
verses.literal: and say to the elders - This son of ours is stubborn and rebellious he does not obey us . . . He is a glutton and a drunkard

verses.original: כָּל־ אַנְשֵׁ֨י עִיר֤וֹ וּ֠רְגָמֻהוּ בָֽאֲבָנִים֙ וָמֵ֔ת וּבִֽעַרְתָּ֥ הָרָ֖ע מִקִּרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְכָל־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל יִשְׁמְע֥וּ וְיִרָֽאוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kāl- ’an·šê ‘î·rōw ū·rə·ḡā·mu·hū ḇā·’ă·ḇā·nîm wā·mêṯ ū·ḇi·‘ar·tā hā·rā‘ miq·qir·be·ḵā wə·ḵāl yiś·rā·’êl yiš·mə·‘ū wə·yi·rā·’ū
verses.literal: Then all the men of his city will stone him . . . to death So you must purge the evil from among you and all Israel will hear and be afraid

verses.original: וְכִֽי־ בְאִ֗ישׁ יִהְיֶ֣ה חֵ֛טְא מִשְׁפַּט־ מָ֖וֶת וְהוּמָ֑ת וְתָלִ֥יתָ אֹת֖וֹ עַל־ עֵֽץ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·ḵî- ḇə·’îš yih·yeh ḥêṭ miš·paṭ- mā·weṯ wə·hū·māṯ wə·ṯā·lî·ṯā ’ō·ṯōw ‘al- ‘êṣ
verses.literal: If a man has committed a sin worthy of death and he is executed and you hang his body on a tree

verses.original: לֹא־ נִבְלָת֜וֹ עַל־ הָעֵ֗ץ תָלִ֨ין כִּֽי־ קָב֤וֹר תִּקְבְּרֶ֙נּוּ֙ הַה֔וּא בַּיּ֣וֹם כִּֽי־ תָּל֑וּי אֱלֹהִ֖ים קִלְלַ֥ת וְלֹ֤א תְטַמֵּא֙ אֶת־ אַדְמָ֣תְךָ֔ אֲשֶׁר֙ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ נֹתֵ֥ן לְךָ֖ נַחֲלָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: lō- niḇ·lā·ṯōw ‘al- hā·‘êṣ ṯā·lîn kî- qā·ḇō·wr tiq·bə·ren·nū ha·hū bay·yō·wm kî- tā·lui ’ĕ·lō·hîm qil·laṯ wə·lō ṯə·ṭam·mê ’eṯ- ’aḏ·mā·ṯə·ḵā ’ă·šer Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·he·ḵā nō·ṯên lə·ḵā na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: you must not leave the body on the tree overnight but you must be sure to bury . . . him that day because anyone who is hung [on a tree] is under God’s curse You must not defile - the land that the LORD your God is giving you as an inheritance
